card.name: Blood level wording after plasma or serum
card.fires_on: The word after plasma, serum or drug (such as level or concentrations) when blood-level monitoring is being described. It also fires on plasma itself after a lead-in about measuring levels.

modes.label: Level or concentration word
modes.description: The noun level or concentrations right after plasma, serum, drug or a drug name in monitoring instructions.
modes.example: Continue until the methotrexate<< level>> is below 5 x 10

modes.label: Plasma or serum itself
modes.description: The word plasma just before levels, in dose-adjustment or titration instructions.
modes.example: Titrate LYSODREN dose to achieve a<< plasma>> level of 14 to 2
